notes.title: Update Notes for August 5
notes.notes:
Fixed bug in moves of Baby Slime.
Further adjusted difficulty of battles on the 6F and 8F.
Added a new skill Wait (Do nothing and gain 1 EP) to Iren and Cecil. You may start a new game to learn this skill.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 3 (2)
notes.notes:
Slightly updated some events on the 8F.
Fixed description of Knight Sculpture in the monster guide.

notes.title: Update Notes for August 3
notes.notes:
Added a new achievement. Win the second last battle without having Miracle potion in your inventory.
Slightly adjusted skill Immortality.
Additional nerf to enemies from the 5F to 8F.
Slightly changed moves of enemies on the 8F.
Fixed a bug where wrong enemy name is displayed on the cursor during a battle.

notes.title: Update Notes for July 28
notes.notes:
Nerfed enemies from the 5F to 8F
Slightly changed moves of some enemies on the 6F and 8F
Fixed a typo on the 3F
Fixed a typo on the 8F
